mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_account u WHERE ) users_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_account u WHERE AND u.gmt_create>=#{today} AND u.gmt_create<#{nextDay}) users_today, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_account u WHERE u.is_deleted=0 AND u.account_status=1 AND u.last_login_at>=#{start} AND u.last_login_at<#{nextDay}) users_active, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM glucose_record g JOIN user_account u ON u.id=g.user_id WHERE AND g.record_date=#{today}) today_glucose, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meal_record m JOIN user_account u ON u.id=m.user_id WHERE AND m.record_date=#{today}) today_meal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM glucose_record g JOIN user_account u ON u.id=g.user_id WHERE AND g.record_date>=#{monthStart} AND g.record_date<#{nextDay}) month_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cms_news n WHERE ) news_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_article_view v JOIN cms_news n ON n.id=v.news_id WHERE AND v.created_at<=#{asOf}) news_views, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feedback f WHERE f.is_deleted=0 AND COALESCE(CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(f.official_reply)),0)=0) feedback_pending, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM food_nutrition f WHERE f.is_deleted=0) food_count

SELECT record_date, SUM(glucose) glucose, SUM(meal) meal, SUM(users) users FROM ( SELECT g.record_date, COUNT(*) glucose, 0 meal, 0 users FROM glucose_record g JOIN user_account u ON u.id=g.user_id WHERE AND g.record_date>=#{start} AND g.record_date<#{nextDay} GROUP BY g.record_date UNION ALL SELECT m.record_date, 0 glucose, COUNT(*) meal, 0 users FROM meal_record m JOIN user_account u ON u.id=m.user_id WHERE AND m.record_date>=#{start} AND m.record_date<#{nextDay} GROUP BY m.record_date UNION ALL SELECT CAST(u.gmt_create AS DATE) record_date, 0 glucose, 0 meal, COUNT(*) users FROM user_account u WHERE AND u.gmt_create>=#{start} AND u.gmt_create<#{nextDay} GROUP BY CAST(u.gmt_create AS DATE) ) daily_counts GROUP BY record_date ORDER BY record_date

SELECT CASE WHEN target_rate>=70 THEN '达标率≥70%' WHEN target_rate>=40 THEN '达标率40%～<70%' ELSE '达标率<40%' END name, COUNT(*) AS `value` FROM ( SELECT g.user_id, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN g.glucose_value>=#{low} AND g.glucose_value<#{high} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),0) target_rate FROM glucose_record g JOIN user_account u ON u.id=g.user_id WHERE AND g.record_date>=#{start} AND g.record_date<#{nextDay} GROUP BY g.user_id ) user_rates GROUP BY name

SELECT CASE n.channel_code WHEN 1 THEN '企业动态' WHEN 2 THEN '行业快讯' WHEN 3 THEN '设备新知' WHEN 4 THEN '控糖科普' ELSE '其他' END name, COUNT(*) AS `value` FROM cms_news n WHERE GROUP BY n.channel_code ORDER BY n.channel_code

SELECT d.node_name name, COALESCE(h.total,0) AS `value` FROM dict_glucose_node d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT node_code, SUM(total) total FROM ( SELECT g.node_code, COUNT(*) total FROM glucose_record g JOIN user_account u ON u.id=g.user_id WHERE AND g.record_date>=#{start} AND g.record_date<#{nextDay} GROUP BY g.node_code UNION ALL SELECT m.node_code, COUNT(*) total FROM meal_record m JOIN user_account u ON u.id=m.user_id WHERE AND m.record_date>=#{start} AND m.record_date<#{nextDay} GROUP BY m.node_code ) node_counts GROUP BY node_code ) h ON h.node_code=d.node_code WHERE d.is_deleted=0 ORDER BY d.sort_no,d.id
